verdict.rationale: Stripe's Financial Connections testing docs say that in testing, the authentication flow shows only Stripe-managed test institutions, and accounts can be linked without real credentials, so no production bank data is touched. A community user's hands-on report that the dashboard sent them to the test dashboard corroborates that a separate test environment exists. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of test-mode vs live-mode keys and data isolation, and detail on simulated balances, transactions and ownership data for test accounts.
